name: side-panel
notes: Full sides. Right panel: cable groove, inlet and outlet sensor holes, ESP32 pattern. Left panel: tile pockets.

name: deck
notes: One sloped lane floor. Install at the module slope.

name: front-apron
notes: Closes the front below the outlet.

name: top-strip
notes: Front and rear strips with hooked stack pockets.

name: stack-foot
notes: Locating foot with a forward toe. Glue or screw under the base.

name: post
notes: Rear corners. 20×20 mm outer envelope only; T-slot is not cut here.

name: rail
notes: Top front and top rear rails. 20×20 mm outer envelope only.

name: lane-guide
notes: Printed side guide. Three 3.4 mm holes in the flange.

name: outlet-gate
notes: Printed lift gate with a finger notch. One per lane.

name: tile-pin
notes: Press into the right side. The left side of the next module has the pocket.

name: M3x12 SHCS
notes: Lane guides into the decks. Clearance drill 3.4 mm (ISO 273 medium).

name: M3x10 SHCS
notes: Two screws at each lane inlet, two at each lane outlet, four on the ESP32 pattern.

name: M3 hex nut
notes: Nuts for the sensor and ESP32 screws.
